the decay Z → ν ν γ gives the most stringent bounds on the neutrino magnetic moment and the decay Z→ ν ν γγ on the neutrino-two-photon interaction.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Z decays Z→ ν ν γ and Z → ν ν γγ are complementary to each other and to ν μ N →ν s N conversion in constraining various neutrino–phosphino and neutrino–photino interactions.
